title: Arson for Spigot
description: A simple spigot plugin that does /arson visually burning you or things around you with /arson all.
body:
## The never beforeseen /arson for Minecraft
The plugin is all visual nothing is really being burnt and it's fully customizable for server owners.

### Commands:
- /arson me | Burn yourself (permission: arson.me)
- /arson all <range> | Burn an entire range of blocks (permission: arson.all)
